LESSON: FLOATING AND SINKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.1: Floating and Sinking

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Floating and Sinking, part of Force and Energy in Grade 5 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.
